description: This file implements the SensorManagerAidl class for Android sensor service, including methods for creating direct channels, event queues, and retrieving sensor information, as well as managing a dedicated looper thread for sensor event polling.

classes.name: SensorManagerAidl
classes.description: Implementation of the sensor manager interface for Android, managing sensor channels, event queues, and a dedicated polling thread.

methods.name: SensorManagerAidl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SensorManagerAidl with a Java VM reference.

methods.name: ~SensorManagerAidl
methods.description: Destructor that stops the polling thread and cleans up.

methods.name: createAshmemDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct channel using shared memory (Ashmem).

methods.name: createGrallocDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct channel using gralloc buffer.

methods.name: createEventQueue
methods.description: Creates a new sensor event queue with a callback.

methods.name: getDefaultSensor
methods.description: Retrieves the default sensor of a specified type.

methods.name: getSensorList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.

methods.name: getLooper
methods.description: Manages and returns the singleton looper thread for sensor event polling.
